answer: Cost first: every reviewer stakes 40 POA per verdict, and a duplicate submission forfeits the stake outright. Then the benefit: a second panel spot checks one verdict in ten, so a false pass costs more than it earns. The kernel is that duplicates are trivial to detect, since the same text hashed twice matches, and the knoll of staked reviewers thins out when someone tries. A whisper of coordination between two reviewers voids both stakes.
